note: Discovered mid-milestone: evaluation_service.evaluate() does exact-string matching against a SEPARATE, private answer_keys.json (ADR-001), not against Question.solution/canonical expectedAnswer (which is worked-explanation prose, never meant for exact match). Stage 10 export never populated this file, so every one of the 44 LE questions 500'd on submission until this artifact existed. Short answers below are hand-extracted from stage6-questions.json's expectedAnswer field, matching the terse style already used for other chapters (e.g. 'Opposite sides are parallel and equal' for understanding-quadrilaterals). Flagging honestly: le-q21 through le-q30 and le-q37 through le-q44 (MCQ-letter answers, compound LHS/RHS answers, multi-part word-problem answers) are inherently weak fits for exact-string matching — a real student could type a differently-worded but equally correct answer and be marked wrong. This is a pre-existing limitation of the exact-match evaluator (Release 0.3 'answer tolerance' is the named future fix, per LearningExperienceArchitecture.md's roadmap mapping), not something introduced or fixable here.
